facts.title: Lemon Vinaigrette
ingredients: ⅓ cup lemon juice (from about 2 lemons)
1 to 2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup, to taste
Freshly ground black pepper, to taste
Pinch of red pepper flakes (optional, for heat)
facts.author: Cookie and Kate

steps.text: Combine all of the ingredients and whisk until blended.

Season generously with black pepper and adjust to taste by adding more honey if the dressing tastes too tart. This dressing keeps well in the refrigerator, covered, for up to 10 days. (The olive oil tends to solidify in the refrigerator, which is normal. Let the dressing warm to room temperature for 5 minutes or microwave it for about 10 seconds before using.)

notes: Recipe adapted from the Liquid Gold salad dressing in my cookbook, Love Real Food.
Make it vegan: Use maple syrup, not honey.
facts.summary: Homemade lemon vinaigrette is far superior to store-bought salad dressings! Fresh lemon shines in this simple recipe using quality ingredients. Recipe yields ¾ cup.
